# Valley fold

> Keystone test fixture: a faithful minimal sheet cartridge. Replaced by the commons'
> real `valley-fold` cartridge when the sheet commons is first pinned.

The valley fold is the first fold of every origami diagram: the paper is folded toward
you along a line, so the crease sinks like a valley. Folded and unfolded again, the
paper keeps a plastic memory of the line — the crease rests a few degrees open instead
of returning flat.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `size` | side of the square, mm |
| `stock` | paper stock card (`kami` by default) |

The fold program has one step: valley-fold the diagonal to 180°.
